name: Hong Kong — Kam Tin Driving Test
description: 3.445 km Kam Tin solo driving test. Eight real Lands Department scenery tiles cover the full loop; the wider Hong Kong map remains unfinished. Temporary 7 m road, original collision/pit/spawns and eight numbered test markers. Practice, one car, clear daytime. No AI. Actual game loading and FPS await user test. Map from Lands Department; source data © Government of the Hong Kong SAR, https://3d.map.gov.hk/ . Roads © OpenStreetMap contributors.
